run_wordcount_compute: run the WordCount measurement to get total and unique word counts from a list of strings
test_wordcount_compute: test the WordCount._compute method with a list of strings and optional max_vocab parameter
review_wordcount_info: review the WordCount._info method that returns MeasurementInfo with features and descriptions
build_wordcount_load: build a word count evaluation by loading the word_count module via evaluate.load and calling compute
summarize_wordcount_usage: summarize the WordCount class that counts total and unique words using sklearn CountVectorizer
